correctness.rationale: A four-tap exact periodic cubic-spline stencil block-diagonalizes under the unitary cell DFT. The two singular values of each conjugate-symmetric block are explicit, with a globally positive difference for noncolliding nodes. A strict polynomial inequality makes the checkerboard block uniquely worst, while partition of unity makes the constant block uniquely best. At node collision every block has precisely one zero singular value. All endpoints and quantifiers are proved; 1085 direct full-matrix checks are corroboration.
